method: Frozen randomly sampled public GitHub READMEs. 19 independently adjudicated error spans become original/corrected pairs; 204 independently adjudicated correct-text spans are traps. Score target regions/families only, not unlabeled surrounding prose. Optional style findings are unscored. No repository-specific accept lists. English dialect policy normalization excluded.
